patch_description: Replace the single log-sum-exp acceptance objective with a phase-dependent composite lower-tail merit. Early annealing should reward configurations with a broadly improved set of the lowest determinant constraints, rather than allowing a temporary improvement in only one triangle to dominate. As cooling progresses, the merit transitions toward the exact minimum and a narrower tail, which is the appropriate regime for equalizing the active constraints of a near-optimal Heilbronn configuration. This directly implements the recommended broad-to-narrow lower-tail guidance while retaining exact-minimum selection for the final returned arrangement.
